heading.description: The heading of the alert, which provides a brief summary of the alert's content.

text.description: The main content of the alert, providing detailed information about the alert.

variant.description: The visual style of the alert, indicating the type of message being conveyed.

slim.description: A boolean that determines whether the alert should be displayed in a more compact, slim style.

noIcon.description: A boolean that determines whether the alert should be displayed without an icon.

className.description: Additional CSS classes to apply to the alert component.

style.description: Inline styles to apply to the alert component.

role.description: Optional ARIA role override. Defaults by variant: error/emergency -> alert, success -> status, info/warning -> region.

ariaLabel.description: Accessible label used when needed (especially for role=region).

ariaLabelledby.description: ID reference to a labeling element. Takes precedence over ariaLabel.

onDismiss.description: Optional callback function that, if provided, makes the alert dismissible and is called when the alert is dismissed.

children.description: Alert rich content (React node / HTML string). If provided, this content will be rendered instead of the `heading` and `text` props.
